description_en: Queries the connection records of authorized users connecting to pooled cloud computers in a cloud computer pool
description_zh: 查询云电脑池的授权用户连接池化云电脑的具体记录
kebab_example: aliyun ecd describe-user-connection-records --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --desktop-group-id dg-2i8qxpv6t1a030000 --end-user-id alice --end-user-type SIMPLE --max-results 10 --next-token caeba0bbb2be03f84eb48b699f0a4883 --connect-start-time-from 1631239200000 --connect-start-time-to 1631241000000 --connect-end-time-from 1631266200000 --connect-end-time-to 1631268000000 --connect-duration-from 100 --connect-duration-to 100 --desktop-id ecd-138dsptkrt00u0000 --api-version 2020-09-30 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeUserConnectionRecords

parameters.help_en: The region ID. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/196646.html to query the regions supported by Elastic Desktop Service
parameters.help_zh: 地域ID。可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/196646.html获取无影云电脑支持的地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The type of user account system. Valid values:

SIMPLE: convenience account
AD_CONNECTOR: enterprise AD account
parameters.name: end_user_type

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries per page for a paged query.

Maximum value: 100.

Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh:
分页查询时每页行数。
最大值：100。
默认值：10
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: The pagination token for the next query. An empty value indicates that there is no next page
parameters.help_zh: 下一个查询开始的Token，NextToken为空表示没有下一个
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The minimum value of the connection start time used as a filter condition. The value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: milliseconds
parameters.help_zh: 以开始连接时间作为筛选条件的最小值。格式为Unix时间戳。单位为毫秒
parameters.name: connect_start_time_from

parameters.help_en: The maximum value of the connection start time used as a filter condition. The value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: milliseconds
parameters.help_zh: 以开始连接时间作为筛选条件的最大值。格式为Unix时间戳。单位为毫秒
parameters.name: connect_start_time_to

parameters.help_en: The minimum value of the connection end time used as a filter condition. The value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: milliseconds
parameters.help_zh: 以终止连接时间作为筛选条件的最小值。格式为Unix时间戳。单位为毫秒
parameters.name: connect_end_time_from

parameters.help_en: The maximum value of the connection end time used as a filter condition. The value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: milliseconds
parameters.help_zh: 以终止连接时间作为筛选条件的最大值。格式为Unix时间戳。单位为毫秒
parameters.name: connect_end_time_to

parameters.help_en: The minimum value of the connection duration used as a filter condition
parameters.help_zh: 以连接时长作为筛选条件的最小值
parameters.name: connect_duration_from

parameters.help_en: The maximum value of the connection duration used as a filter condition
parameters.help_zh: 以连接时长作为筛选条件的最大值
parameters.name: connect_duration_to
